messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx spike and latency for requests routed to Dedicated pool dp-87 (customer: NovaFin, VPC us-east-2). Automated monitor shows prefix-cache hit rate for tenant nova_fin dropped from ~78% to ~3% over the last 12m. Paging on-call.

raj: taking this — oncall (sre) here. paging details? any obvious recent deploys to dp-87?

pagerduty: Pager duty alert: PD#12345 -> SRE oncall (raj).

alex: logs show repeated eviction churn from prefix-cache-worker-2 in dp-87. lots of `evict(prefix=...)` messages followed by `miss -> regen` floods. linking a short tail:```
2026-03-15T21:19:02Z prefix-cache evict tenant=nova_fin size=4096 reason=quota
2026-03-15T21:19:02Z prefix-cache miss tenant=nova_fin key=sha1:...
2026-03-15T21:19:03Z inference serve request id=... status=502 model=redwood-rlhf-xl
```

sofia: confirmed — eviction rate jumped right after a scheduled config push 21:18 (dp-87 prefix cache tuning). That push touched global eviction thresholds.

mia: cc @customer-eng — was NovaFin on the change window?

customer-eng: NovaFin had a maintenance window earlier but they weren't supposed to get the global tuning change. Investigating why their tenant config picked it up. Reached out to account contact (simon@nnovafin).

raj: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable prefix-cache for tenant nova_fin (fast) 2) purge current cache entries for nova_fin 3) scale dp-87 by +2 workers temporarily. Which ops can run step 1?

ops-oncall: I can run it. Command I'm about to use (run in prod-admin):
```
# disable tenant prefix cache
rwdctl tenant-config set --tenant nova_fin --prefix_cache.enabled=false --pool dp-87
# purge existing entries
rwdctl cache purge --tenant nova_fin --prefixes "*" --pool dp-87
```

alex: note: purging will cause cold starts and a spike in backend compute but should stop the eviction churn and 502s. recommend also enabling fallback to model-quantized-variant for long tails.

sofia: pushing fallback routing for nova_fin -> redwood-rlhf-xl-quantized as soft-fallback now (canary)

raj: go for disable+purge now. keep me posted on error rate and hit-rate metric.

ops-oncall: running disable now... (started)
ops-oncall: purge job started (job id: purge-1799408). ETA ~90s.

alex: watching metrics (prefix_cache.hit_rate{tenant=nova_fin}) -> 03% then purge in progress...

sofia: routing fallback enabled.

customer-eng: told NovaFin we are investigating and applying mitigations. They reported increased latency and occasional 502s for ~10-15m. asked them to pause heavy batch workloads if possible.

ops-oncall: purge done. disabled flag set. scaling pool dp-87 +2 instances (request sent to autoscale controller).

alex: post-mitigation metrics: prefix_cache.hit_rate for nova_fin jumped to 60% (cached client-side warmers) and 5xx back to baseline. latency improving but still noisy for a few minutes.

raj: good. immediate customer impact: brief window (~12m) of errors and elevated latency for NovaFin production traffic; likely few failed user requests but no data loss. SRE to keep increased monitoring for 2h.

mia: I'm taking handoff at 22:00 UTC. raj — anything outstanding for me to own?

raj: handoff notes: root cause appears to be global eviction threshold change rolled to dp-87 that incorrectly applied to tenant nova_fin, causing aggressive per-tenant eviction and cache pollution. Temporary mitigations applied: disabled tenant prefix cache, purged entries, enabled fallback routing, scaled pool. Next steps owned by oncall (mia): 1) monitor metrics for 2h 2) coordinate with infra to revert the global config propagation rule for VPC tenants (patch in progress) 3) confirm with customer-eng that NovaFin systems are nominal 4) open postmortem and schedule permanent fix (per-tenant cache quotas + safer rollout gating).

mia: got it. I'll watch and follow up. pinging infra-ops to hold the config rollout. @sofia can you add the temporary routing and revert if we see regressions?

sofia: will hold. added alert: `nova_fin_prefix_eviction_rate>20` to trigger immediate notice.

customer-eng: NovaFin replied: thanks for the fast response. They've resumed normal workflows and will share logs if they see anything else. Asked for a postmortem and ETA for permanent fix.

raj: assign owners for follow-ups: SRE (mia) to monitor & draft incident timeline, Infra (alex) to root cause why global change hit VPC tenant, Eng-platform (sofia) to design per-tenant cache quota + rollout gating, Customer-eng to coordinate postmortem and communicate to NovaFin.

ops-oncall: note for runbook: add a quick `rwdctl tenant-config get --tenant X` check to validate config scope before pushing global tuning.

mia: taking the pager handoff. I'll post interim update in ~30m.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Pages resolved. Severity: sev2 -> investigating (mitigated for customer impact).

sofia: quick note for postmortem: consider adding a tenant isolation policy that prevents global eviction threshold pushes from touching VPC-dedicated pools unless explicit opt-in.

mia: closing update at 22:45 UTC: metrics stable, 5xx rates returned to baseline, NovaFin confirms normal ops. Will coordinate postmortem doc and follow-ups.

raj: thanks team. action items logged. :thumbsup:
